Data Analysis

Data Source

I extracted the data using the spotify package, and stored it in the data folder.

Import Data

#Packages needed for analysis
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

# importing the dataset
Loreen_Data <- read.csv("C:/Users/prady/OneDrive/Documents/P.Arora_SpotifyReport/Loreen.csv")

Simplifying Data

Now, I have saved the tracks as individuals to avoid duplicates of the same tracks. I have also cleared for live versions.

# Remove the tracks with same names
Loreen_Data <- Loreen_Data |> distinct(track_name, .keep_all = TRUE)
# Change the data type of album_name from numeric into character
Loreen_Data$album_name <- as.character(Loreen_Data$album_name)

Album Analysis

Here are box plots comparing Loreen’s albums in terms of valance and energy.

Ps - The data does not include her singles that came after 2023.

# Change album_name from character to factor before plotting
Loreen_Data$album_name <- as.factor(Loreen_Data$album_name)
# plotting a boxplot
ggplot(Loreen_Data, aes(x=album_name, y = valence))+ geom_boxplot()+ labs(x="Album name", y = "Valence")
#plotting another boxplot for energy
ggplot(Loreen_Data, aes(x=album_name, y=energy))+ geom_boxplot()+
  labs(x="Album name", y="Energy")

Now, I was interested in knowing whether her songs can be considered danceable and energetic.

# Deciphering a relationship between Loreen's songs energy and danceability
ggplot(Loreen_Data, aes(x = energy, y = danceability, color = album_name)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = "grey") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, color = "grey")

The Most Positive Songs

Loreen sings a lot about love and heartbreak, so I wanted to see what are her most positive songs (according to the valance) from the data available:

Loreen_Data |> slice_max(valence, n=3) |> dplyr::select(track_name, album_name, album_release_year, valence) |> knitr::kable(digits = 2)
track_name album_name album_release_year valence
Euphoria (WAWA Remix) Euphoria (The Alternative Mixes) 2023 0.78

Euphoria (Alex Moreno Remix) Euphoria (The Alternative Mixes) 2023 0.56
